# Contibute

Welcome all! This is a personal site, and I don't expect much of an following,
but anyone is welcome to help.
Contribute by creating issues (and pull requests solving isues)
that address what you think needs work.

Follow the Code of Conduct while interacting in the community.
Additionaly be aware that proposed additions, ideas or changes may not be accepted,
thought I will provide reason for all responses.

*Note: this doc is partly a placeholder:*
*it will be expanded if needed as things come up.*

Reach out with any futher questions, or regaring moderator opertunties,
sponsership deals, or simmilar, at [`contact@librarianofstars.ca`](mailto:contact@librarianofstars.ca).
